name: Atlas Call Intelligence - Monthly Report
description: گزارش ماهانه عملکرد فروش و پشتیبانی بر اساس تحلیل تماس‌ها

parameters.query: SELECT call_id, department, agent_id, agent_name, customer_phone, call_date, purchase_intent_score, satisfaction_final_score, agent_quality_score, ticket_priority, needs_human_review, analysis_json FROM call_analyses WHERE call_date >= $1::timestamptz AND call_date < $2::timestamptz ORDER BY call_date ASC

INSERT INTO monthly_reports (report_month, department, report_json, total_calls) VALUES ($1::date, 'all', $2::jsonb, $3) ON CONFLICT (report_month, department) DO UPDATE SET report_json = EXCLUDED.report_json, total_calls = EXCLUDED.total_calls, created_at = NOW() RETURNING id
